mode.description: How membership is reconciled: extend (only adds) or strict (adds and removes).

members.description: How many individual addresses are listed beside the groups; the addresses are the record's targets.

sources.description: How many directory groups feed it; the groups are the record's targets.

reason.description: Historical: carried by records written under catalogue 1.3.0 to 1.5.0 (takeover when a policy channel defined in git was taken over, empty otherwise) and no longer written. Declared so those records still read.

changes.description: For an edit, what changed, as 'field: before -> after' parts; empty otherwise.
